_doc: Rain's mouth as bone poses per Rhubarb shape (rigs.ActionVisemes). Bones are CloudRig controls of the 'Face Main' collection. rot is degrees, loc metres, scale a multiplier. Calibrated 2026-11-05 on Blender 5.2.3 by render: MSTR-Jaw rot X +25 opens the jaw with teeth and tongue; MSTR-Mouth scale X 1.6 widens the lips (gum artefacts appear above ~1.4), 0.5 purses them; ACT-Lips_Corner loc X +-0.01 does nothing (its limit constraints clamp it); MSTR-LowerLip loc Z -0.01 drops the lower lip. The in-between values are interpolated from those three measurements, not each rendered: re-judge on the clip.
